programs.name: mutating
programs.source:
struct Counter:
    var n: Int64
    mutating func add(value: Int64) -> Int64:
        self.n += value
        return self.n
    mutating func reset():
        self = Counter(0)
        return
struct Group:
    var counter: Counter
var group = Group(Counter(1))
let before = group
assert(group.counter.add(2) == 3)
assert(group.counter.n == 3 && before.counter.n == 1)
group.counter.reset()
assert(group.counter.n == 0)
